units.source_text: 可是，寺庙的人从副司那里一听说这件事，都认定是我手的。

en.t: But as soon as the people at the temple heard about it from the deputy priest, they all decided that I had done it.

units.source_text: 离川握住了我的手，眼泪几乎夺眶而出，

en.t: Rikawa gripped my hand, his tears almost spilling from his eyes,

units.source_text: 他用透明的目光凝视着我，他的少年般的纯真的声音搏击着我。

en.t: He gazed at me with clear, transparent eyes, and his boyishly innocent voice struck me.
